inspection_method: original awesome-list GitHub URL failed with authentication/not-found behavior; public site and Edit-on-GitHub links resolved the active repository to Mondrethos/gatekeeperwiki; inspected resolved repo, site contribution page, Quartz config, deploy workflow, RSS-to-Markdown script, and content tree

anchors.why: Shows a Quartz-style public wiki with explorer, search, graph, table of contents, backlinks, and edit links.
Explains that pages are Markdown files on GitHub, edits should be made through branches, and approved changes update the live site through automation.
Identifies the active repository as an Obsidian/Quartz fan wiki and points to the contribution document.
Stores wiki pages as Markdown under a content folder.
Configures Quartz plugins, crawl links, content index, RSS/sitemap, remove drafts, and ignores private/templates/.obsidian paths.
Builds Quartz and deploys GitHub Pages from main.
Sanitizes filenames, parses RSS, downloads images, hashes content, and generates Markdown entries.

known_limits: The awesome-list repository URL was stale or inaccessible; active provenance was recovered through the public site's edit links.
Game wiki content itself is domain material and should not be imported into VAKS.
Feed-to-Markdown and publish automation must remain candidate/projection workflows, not reviewed knowledge or action basis.
